info.title: ky-ai-terminal — a shell you drive normally while an AI agent joins over MCP.
info.description: Shared interactive terminal for AI agents: you drive a real shell (cmd/powershell/ssh/…) while an agent joins the same live session over MCP (read-only / suggest / auto). Windows-only (ConPTY).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Just run `ky-ai-terminal` to start a session; the `run` word is optional.

options.name: --shell
options.description: cmd | powershell | pwsh | bash | ssh | <exe path> (default: pwsh)

options.name: --mode
options.description:
read | suggest | auto  (default: suggest)
read    — agent can only read the screen/scrollback
suggest — agent proposes; you approve with the chord below
auto    — agent types directly (when idle at a prompt)

options.name: --name
options.description: Session name in the hub (default: folder name)

options.name: --scrollback
options.description: Scrollback lines kept for the agent (default: 5000)

options.name: --prefix
options.description:
Multiplexer prefix chord (default: Ctrl-B). Then:
<prefix> Enter = approve · <prefix> Esc = dismiss · <prefix> m = cycle mode

options.name: --audit
options.description: Mirror the agent-injection audit log to a file

options.name: --hub-port
options.description: Hub port to register with (default: 5103; rarely needed — does not start a hub)

options.name: --no-hub
options.description: Standalone: local control API only; no hub, no agent access
